title: Scrutinized List - Lecturer in Food Science Technology-Advertisement No. 69(2026)
text:
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

Office of the Registrar

Official Announcement

Advertisement No. 69 (2026)

Lecturer in Food Science Technology

Provisional Scrutiny Lists and Quantification

With reference to
Advertisement No. 69 (2026)

for the position of
Lecturer in Food Science Technology
,
published in the national dailies and on the University's official
website on
July 11, 2026
, and the subsequent
screening test conducted by ETEA on
August 8, 2026
,
it is hereby informed that all applicants who qualified the
screening test and submitted their applications through the
online portal by the closing date have been scrutinized by the
Scrutiny and Quantification Committee.

The scrutiny has been conducted strictly in accordance with
the relevant Statutes, rules, and the eligibility criteria
specified in the advertisement.

The scrutinized lists, along with provisional quantification,
have been uploaded and are available through the link below.

View Scrutinized Lists (https://jobs.awkum.edu.pk/public-posts/Cm4rzun31C93pEawOqM5a7fvGnHZTwmzoRYgpdPo)

Open Online Job Portal (https://jobs.awkum.edu.pk)

Applicants are advised to check their respective status.
In case of any appeal, applicants must log in to the online
portal using the same credentials they used when submitting
their original applications.

Terms and Conditions for Appeals

All these lists are provisional and shall not be considered
as merit lists. The names appear in the order in which
candidates submitted their applications for the concerned
position.

The provisional merit list may be revised, cancelled,
or revoked, in whole or in part, if any information is
found to be incorrect, misleading, or not in conformity
with the advertised criteria, relevant Statutes, or
applicable rules.

Candidates may review the marks awarded to them by the
Scrutiny and Quantification Committee in each category:

Academics, Distinction, Experience, Publications,
and Research Projects
, by logging into the job
portal using their original application credentials.
In case of login issues, the instructions on the portal
may be followed to recover access.

If a candidate is not satisfied with the marks awarded
by the Scrutiny and Quantification Committee, an appeal
may be filed. Objections to scrutiny marks shall only
be entertained if supported by documentary evidence.

Appeals shall be justified only on the basis of documents
already submitted at the time of application. Candidates
are strictly advised not to submit any new documents
during the appeal process.

Appeals shall be submitted online through the designated
portal by the prescribed deadline. Any appeal received
after the deadline or submitted through any other means
shall not be entertained.

Last Date for Submission of Appeals

November 17, 2026

Submit Appeal Online (https://jobs.awkum.edu.pk)

Errors and omissions are liable to rectification.

In case of any query, please contact the office of
the undersigned.

Registrar

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
